t: You're at King's College Hospital in Denmark Hill, Camberwell, known locally simply as King's. It's a major teaching hospital and major trauma centre, serving around seven hundred thousand people in Southwark and Lambeth. Many people have been born and have died here. Queen Camilla was born here, as was the socialite Annabelle Neilson, who was a muse to the designer Alexander McQueen. The playwright Sarah Kane died here, as did the Antarctic explorer Leonard Hussey, who was with Shackleton at his death, and the gangster Frankie Fraser.
